purpose: Detect repeated chapter functions across the long arc.
wired_into: runtime/serialize/loop.py — folded over the produced sequence as result.function_repeat (advisory, never gates, ADR-003)
tested_by: tests/test_serial_function_repeat.py (3 patterns + healthy/short degrade + v8 liveness + reproducibility)
output_shape: ReviewReport {reviewer, axis=evaluative, gating=false, findings:[{check:function-repeat, severity, message}]}
notes: Signature keys on stable enum-like fields the generation chain already produces; surface fields are excluded so renamed_same_function can be distinguished from a true duplicate.
The real 33-ch baseline (RUN-00025) has 25 consecutive chapters sharing one signature — the finding this detector was built to surface.
stalled_progression from the original scaffold is covered by the sibling director/mandate_check.check_mandate_series (张力停滞/原地打转), not duplicated here.
